items.title: Farewell Ai2
items.summary: I’m departing the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2), where I got the great privilege to work on the Olmo models, to grow, to learn, and to have broad lasting impacts. This post is an attempt to reflect on why what we did was influential, despite obviously being far from the frontier in performance (even when within size buckets), and how this reflects on various paths to impact in AI today. items.summaryZh: Hugging Face发布了Holo3.1计算机操作智能体系列，旨在提升跨网页、桌面和移动端等多种图形用户界面（GUI）环境下的鲁棒性。基于Qwen系列构建的Holo3.1不仅保留了最先进的性能，还首次发布了针对本地推理优化的量化检查点，包括FP8、Q4 GGUF和NVFP4，推动了通用计算机操作智能体向全平台和本地化部署迈进。

items.title: Travelers deploys AI-powered claims countrywide with OpenAI
items.summary: Travelers built an AI-powered Claim Assistant with OpenAI to guide customers through filing claims, provide 24/7 support, and scale operations during peak demand.
items.summaryZh: 旅游者保险公司（Travelers）宣布与OpenAI合作，在全美范围内正式部署AI驱动的理赔助手（Claim Assistant）。该系统旨在全天候引导客户完成理赔申请流程，并在业务高峰期有效扩展公司的客服与运营规模，是企业级大模型真实落地的典型案例。

aiReview.reasonZh: 展示了大型保险公司在全国范围内大面积部署基于大模型的理赔助手应用的实际落地案例。
